message.content: Use the AskUserQuestion tool right now in ONE call with exactly four single-select questions about planning a team offsite (headers Venue, Catering, Schedule, Transport). Each question must have 4 options, and every option label must be a long phrase of 8 to 12 words, each with a one-sentence description. Do not write any other text.

questions.question: Which venue style should we book for the team offsite?

options.label: Rustic mountain lodge with large meeting room and hiking trails
options.description: A secluded retreat that blends focused work sessions with outdoor team activities.

options.label: Modern downtown hotel conference suite near restaurants and nightlife
options.description: A convenient city location with professional AV and plenty of evening options.

options.label: Lakeside cabin compound with shared kitchen and fire pit area
options.description: A relaxed, casual setting that encourages informal bonding and small-group conversations.

options.label: Coworking space event floor rented privately for the whole day
options.description: A budget-friendly option with flexible layouts, fast Wi-Fi, and minimal travel.

questions.question: How should we handle food and drinks during the offsite?

options.label: Full-service catered buffet covering breakfast, lunch, and afternoon snacks
options.description: One vendor handles all meals so the team never has to leave the venue.

options.label: Local food trucks rotating through for lunch on each day
options.description: Adds variety and a fun atmosphere while supporting local small businesses.

options.label: Team cooking class dinner led by a professional private chef
options.description: Turns a meal into a hands-on team-building activity everyone can enjoy together.

options.label: Individual meal stipends so everyone chooses their own nearby restaurants
options.description: Maximizes dietary flexibility and personal choice with simple expense tracking.

questions.question: What overall schedule structure should the offsite follow?

options.label: Two full days with strategy sessions in mornings and activities afternoons
options.description: Balances deep planning work with energizing team-building time each day.

options.label: Single intensive day packed with workshops from nine to five
options.description: Keeps costs and time away from work low while covering key topics.

options.label: Three relaxed days mixing light agenda items with plenty of downtime
options.description: Prioritizes rest and organic connection over a tightly packed formal agenda.

options.label: Half-day workshop followed by an evening dinner and social event
options.description: A lightweight format that fits easily into a normal work week.

questions.question: How should the team travel to and from the offsite venue?

options.label: Chartered coach bus departing together from the main office parking lot
options.description: Everyone arrives at the same time and the ride itself becomes social time.

options.label: Individual travel with mileage and parking fully reimbursed by the company
options.description: Gives people flexibility to arrive and leave on their own schedules.

options.label: Organized carpools grouped by neighborhood with a designated driver per car
options.description: Reduces cost and parking needs while encouraging cross-team mingling on the way.

options.label: Booked flights and airport shuttle transfers arranged by an assistant
options.description: Necessary for distant venues and removes all logistics burden from attendees.
